cohort: 43 pregnant women with cardiac disease admitted to a tertiary care hospital in Peshawar, Pakistan, between January 2019 and January 2020.
finding: Among 10,263 pregnant women, 0.42% (n=43) had cardiac disease, with cardiomyopathy being the most prevalent (27.9%), resulting in a maternal mortality of 4.7% and fetal mortality of 9.3%.
